sources.review_notes: All 32 pages reviewed against page renders by four reviewer agents (pages 1-7, 8-15, 16-23, 24-32; reports in reports/review-pages-*.md): reading order of the two-column main text rebuilt, joins set across columns and pages, every display equation (1)-(38) and unnumbered display transcribed from the authors' TeX and compared with high-resolution crops, Algorithms 1-3 cropped and transcribed, 20 tables transcribed cell by cell, 12 figures re-boxed (fragmented extractor tiles merged), bibliography order repaired. Remaining verifier diagnostics are LaTeX-notation differences (maths, U+2212 minus, mapsto glyph, maths commas, glued table cells in the second parser), adjudicated per page.
